data.name: Anaf
data.gender_notes: Anaf is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who gives or helps others. The name Anaf carries the meaning “Giver, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Anaf usually hope their child will grow to embody giver, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person who gives or helps others spiritually
data.etymology: Anaf belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Giver, Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anaf total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: عانف
in_arabic.meaning: العانف يعني الشخص الذي يتألف من العطف والحنان
in_arabic.long_meaning: العانف هو اسم مشتق من الفعل عانف، والذي يعني الترحم والتألف. يعتبر اسم عانف من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة وصفات رفيعة، حيث يوحي بالعطف والحنان. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات، مما يعطيه قيمة دينية كبيرة. يستخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية كاسم للمولود الجديد، نظرًا لمعناه العميق ودلالاته الإيجابية.

in_urdu.name: عانف
in_urdu.meaning: عانف کا مطلب ہے رحمت اور محبت سے بھرا ہوا
in_urdu.long_meaning: عانف ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے رحمت اور محبت سے بھرا ہوا۔ یہ نام عانف فعل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا معنی ہے ترحم اور ہمدردی۔ اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام اچھے اخلاق اور دلی کھلے پن کی علامت ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیا میں مسلمان والدین اپنے بچوں کو یہ نام دیتے ہیں تاکہ وہ رحمت اور محبت کے ساتھ زندگی گزار سکیں۔

in_hindi.name: आनफ
in_hindi.meaning: आनफ का अर्थ है दयालु और प्रेम से भरा हुआ
in_hindi.long_meaning: आनफ एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है दयालु और प्रेम से भरा हुआ। यह नाम 'عانف' (Anaf) से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है दया करना और हमदर्दी दिखाना। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम बच्चे के अच्छे गुणों और स्वभाव की प्रतीक के रूप में दिया जाता है। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में गहरा अर्थ रखता है और अक्सर माता-पिता द्वारा अपने बच्चों को सकारात्मक मूल्य प्रदान करने के लिए चुना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: عانف
in_pashto.meaning: عانف د رحمت او مینې څخه ډک نوم دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: عانف د عربی نوم دی چې د رحمت او مینې څخه ډک معنی لري. دا نوم د 'عانف' کلمې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې د رحم او شفقت معنی لري. په افغانستان او پښتونستان کې، دا نوم د مثبتو ځانګړتیاو او ښو اخلاقو د لرونکي کیدو لپاره ورکول کیږي. دا نوم د اسلامي ارزښتونو سره سم دی او د مسلمانو کورنیو لخوا د خپلو ماشومانو لپاره غوره کیږي.

in_english.name: Anaf
in_english.meaning: Anaf means full of mercy, compassion, and love
in_english.long_meaning: The name Anaf originates from Arabic roots, specifically from the verb 'anafa,' which means to be merciful or to show compassion. In Islamic tradition, Anaf is considered a name that embodies positive qualities such as kindness, empathy, and affection. The name has been used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting its significance in Islamic values and teachings. It symbolizes the desirable traits of a compassionate and caring individual.

data.cultural_impact: The name Anaf holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic world, particularly in the realm of altruism and compassion. The name is derived from the Arabic word "anfa" which translates to "to give" or "to help" and is rooted in Islamic values of providing assistance, caring for the needy, and giving to others. The name Anaf is reminiscent of the virtue of generosity (saddaqa) and is a call to prioritize the welfare of others in society.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Anaf can be seen as a reminder of the importance of selflessness, kindness, and charitable giving. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) emphasized the significance of giving and helping others, stating, "It is obligatory for every Muslim to give in charity." (Bukhari & Muslim). The name Anaf can be seen as a reflection of a person's spiritual state, highlighting their connection to their community and their commitment to serving others. By carrying the name Anaf, one is encouraged to embody these Islamic values in their daily life, fostering a spirit of generosity, kindness, and compassion.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Giver, Helper" symbolizes A person who gives or helps others. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Anaf serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of giver, helper.
